Subject: MAP draft - Load test scheduling / traffic replay (Bluefin)

Hi Jordan / Priya —

Great to meet earlier. Per our discovery, I’ve attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the load/perf milestone so we can lock the window for traffic replay and capacity sizing. Key items in this note:

- Target test window: Aug 10–12 (candidate)
- Replay data required: 7 days of production traffic capture (PCAP + replay config)
- Peak QPS target: ~1,200 peak QPS (approx; please confirm)
- Redwood responsibilities: provide dedicated test pool (4 x A10G equiv.), replay infra, test script + monitoring dashboard
- Bluefin responsibilities: provide sanitized traffic capture, list of critical endpoints, business peak windows, and an internal owner for the test day

Attachments: bluefin_map_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), traffic_capture_20260712.pcap (sample), replay_config.json (replay params stub)

Next steps:
1) Jordan/Priya: confirm peak QPS and whether we need burst/steady profile or a mixed profile by EOD Fri (Jul 17)
2) Redwood (Aditya/Vivek): validate the replay config and confirm sizing by Mon (Jul 20)
3) Schedule final test slot and send calendar invites once both sides confirm

If that timeline works I’ll update the MAP with the target close date and owners.

Thanks —

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0191

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 17 Jul 2026 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft - Load test scheduling / traffic replay (Bluefin)

Thanks Marissa — quick technical clarifications from our side before we finalize sizing:

1) The sample PCAP you attached looks good as a format. Can you confirm whether requests include authentication tokens we should scrub or if you can provide a sanitized capture?
2) For peak QPS: is 1,200 sustained for 15 minutes, or are you seeing short bursts to 1,200 on top of a steady baseline? If bursts, please provide the burst duration distribution (15s / 60s / 5m).
3) Do you expect any long sequences that will create large KV cache state for the LLM (e.g., long chat sessions)? That affects memory allocation on the dedicated pool.

If Jordan/Priya can answer items 1–3, I can confirm the exact instance mix (we’re currently modeling 4 x A10G equiv. for baseline, and 6 x A10G if we see sustained 1,200 QPS for >10min).

- Aditya
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai

From: Jordan Park <jordan.park@bluefin.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Menon <priya.menon@bluefin.io>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft - Load test scheduling / traffic replay (Bluefin)

Marissa / Aditya —

Thanks for the recap and the MAP. Quick answers below:

1) We can provide a sanitized capture by EOD Tue (Jul 21). We’ve removed PII and will strip auth tokens; the capture will include endpoint paths and request payload sizes.
2) Peak behavior: baseline ~300 QPS. We see short bursts up to 1,200 QPS that are typically 30–90 seconds long (most common ~45s). We’ll include the burst distribution in the capture metadata.
3) Session lengths: most user sessions are short (turn count < 6). No large KV cache state expected.

We’re aligned on the candidate window Aug 10–12. Please confirm Redwood will provision the dedicated pool and share test-day runbook (start/stop checklist, monitoring links).

Jordan Park
Senior Engineering Manager | Bluefin Analytics
jordan.park@bluefin.io | +1 212-555-0156

Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2026 15:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft - Load test scheduling / traffic replay (Bluefin)

Thanks Jordan — that data is perfect and confirms our sizing model. Final MAP updates and actions below:

- Final target test window: Aug 10, 09:00–13:00 PT (primary); Aug 11 backup slot 09:00–13:00 PT
- Sizing: 4 x A10G equiv. for baseline with autoscale allowance to 6 x A10G for sustained bursts >10m.
- Redwood deliverables (owner):
  * Provision dedicated test pool & QOS config (Vivek) — complete by Aug 3
  * Deploy replay infra and dashboard (Aditya) — complete by Aug 7
  * Test-day runbook + alert thresholds (Aditya) — share by Aug 5
- Bluefin deliverables (owner):
  * Sanitized traffic capture + burst metadata (Jordan) — by Jul 21 (confirmed)
  * List of critical endpoints & success criteria (Priya) — by Jul 24

Target close date for the MAP milestone: Aug 12, 2026 (post-test wrap & sizing sign-off).

I’ll update the MAP spreadsheet and send calendar invites for Aug 10 test slot once Priya confirms endpoints.

— Vivek Kulkarni
